title: Match the exact child seat to the exact seating position before buying a car
meta_description: Check the exact child seat, vehicle and seating position before buying. Understand manuals, compatibility tools, trained trial fits and purchase records.
h1: Match the exact child seat to the exact seating position before buying a car
author: AutoBridge Export Editorial Team
image_alt: Three-panel editorial diagram showing three purchasing questions from the article.
image_caption: Original editorial diagram, not a photograph of a vehicle or an inspection.
summary: A child seat with a familiar brand name may still leave an important purchase question unanswered: is that exact model suitable for the particular position where you intend to use it in the car you are considering? Start with the restraint's identity and proposed position. Counting seats or spotting an ISOFIX or LATCH label cannot answer that question on its own.
